notes: two sayings in one report: «وسئل الحسن بن علي بن محمد عليهم السلام ... فقال: هو التصديق» has no transmitter of its own; the chain «حدثني أبي، عن أبيه، عن جده، عن الصادق» relays Sadiq's saying. Whether the chain covers the Hasan answer is a ruling
the Imam asked in «وسئل الحسن بن علي» is named before the chain, not in it, so he is not written as a link
«أبي» and «أبيه» and «جده» are bare relations, so each is a relation link
